module.title: GlitchSmith Library
module.description: Shared backend services for GlitchSmith modules. Installed automatically as a dependency by other GlitchSmith packages. Not intended for standalone use.

menu.name: Currency Definitions
menu.label: Configure Currencies
menu.hint: Define sheet and virtual currencies shared across GlitchSmith modules (Stylish Shop, Smartphone Widget, Unboxing Mystery).

dialog.title: Currency Definitions
dialog.intro: Define currencies used by GlitchSmith modules. Sheet currencies can map to actor data paths or embedded item quantities. Virtual currencies are stored in this library and shared across all modules.
dialog.sheetHint: Currencies stored on the actor sheet (e.g. dnd5e gp/sp/cp) or as actor-owned items. Actor Path is used for direct actor values; Embedded Item uses the fields below the row.
dialog.virtualHint: Virtual currencies tracked by the library and synced across modules. Balances live in the library wallet, not on actor sheets.
dialog.noPreset: No built-in preset for this game system.
dialog.resetSheetConfirm: Replace sheet currencies with the active system's built-in defaults? Current sheet entries will be discarded.

scan.hint: Select a token or assign a character to your user, then scan to list its item-based currencies.
scan.searchPlaceholder: Search candidates by name, type, or filter...
scan.noActor: No actor found. Select a token or assign a character to your user.
scan.empty: No item-based currency candidates found on {actor}.
scan.testInvalid: Set a quantity path and an item type or filter before testing.
scan.testFail: {actor}: no item matched the current fields.
scan.dropHint: Or drag a currency item from the sidebar or a compendium here to auto-fill.
scan.dropInvalid: Drop a valid Item to auto-fill the currency fields.

hideHeaderButton.name: Hide Wallet sheet header button
hideHeaderButton.hint: Hide the GlitchSmith Library virtual wallet button from Actor sheet headers on this client. Wallet balances and APIs remain available.

dialog.title: Virtual Currency Wallet
dialog.hint: Adjust this actor's virtual currency balances. Sheet currencies (system coins) are managed on the actor sheet.
dialog.noCurrencies: No virtual currencies are defined. Add some via Game Settings → Currency Definitions.

setting.name: Combine GlitchSmith Actor sheet menus
setting.hint: Collect Actor sheet header controls added by GlitchSmith modules into a single GlitchSmith dropdown on this client. Enabled by default.
